method: Fresh CLI sessions; source inputs without reference answers; configured host defaults; one temporary skill copy per run. Only synthetic inputs and sanitized outputs are published.
limits: Small, non-randomized sample; no baseline comparison or human preference study.
Implicit activation was tested before the final output-format clarification; description and routing were unchanged. Explicit tests were rerun after that clarification.
The final Claude explicit run emitted no reference-read tool calls; the initial explicit run and both implicit runs did read the relevant guides. Consistent reference loading is not established.
Spanish and mixed-language examples are smoke coverage, not native-speaker validation.
Visual/profile-creation tasks were not executed. File writes were restricted, so absence of profile writes does not prove unrestricted write restraint.
initial_finding: Claude initially returned fenced JSON plus unrequested change notes. Added an explicit output-format rule; both final explicit runs returned parseable JSON without appended notes.
